channel.title: Ishfaq Ahmad Bhat — Writing
channel.description: Security writeups, research notes and thoughts on teaching security.

item.title: Why I built a free 485-lesson security course
item.author: bhatishfaq966@gmail.com (Ishfaq Ahmad Bhat)
item.description: Most "beginner" security material assumes you already know Linux, networking and how the web works. KashSec started as an attempt to fix that gap — and turned into 26 paths.

item.title: JWT verification: the four ways it actually breaks
item.author: bhatishfaq966@gmail.com (Ishfaq Ahmad Bhat)
item.description: alg=none is the famous one, but it's rarely the bug you find. A walk through the failure modes I keep seeing in real APIs, and what a correct verifier looks like.

item.title: Prompt injection is an architecture problem
item.author: bhatishfaq966@gmail.com (Ishfaq Ahmad Bhat)
item.description: You cannot prompt your way out of prompt injection. The fix is the same one we already use everywhere else in security: don't give the untrusted thing authority.
